notes:
What's new

- Uninstalling now removes everything the app created: preferences, reading progress, logs and the previous-version backup, instead of leaving them behind.
- Release builds can be code-signed: the publisher signs the app and the installer, timestamps them, and verifies the signature when a certificate is configured.
- Uninstall and reinstall are covered by an automated round-trip test.
changelog: WinPreview 1.3.25 - uninstall hygiene and release signing. The uninstaller now deletes HKCU\Software\WinPreview and %LOCALAPPDATA%\WinPreview (settings, logs, rollback backup). publish.ps1 gains -Sign with PFX/thumbprint support, sha256 + timestamp, and signature verification; the CI tag job signs when secrets are present. New tests/uninstall_test.py runs a silent uninstall + reinstall round-trip (15 checks).
